title: Local-to-global for τ(M, θ, ξ) via a smooth partition of unity
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, X ∈ D_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k), and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ. Suppose every x ∈ U has an open V ∋ x such that X(ω) = τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) for every ω ∈ Dᵏ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ V, where τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω. Then X(ω) = τ(M,θ,ξ)(ω) for every ω ∈ Dᵏ(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ V : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω
